## Description

Buy stocks with lower price-to-earnings ratios, often after profitability, leverage and sector filters.

## Where it may fit

Markets with broad valuation dispersion and improving or stable earnings.

## Vehicles

Value equity funds, dividend/value ETFs, fundamental long-short portfolios.

## Required data

Point-in-time price, diluted EPS/earnings, reporting dates, corporate actions, sector and quality metrics.

## Caveats

Negative/one-off earnings make P/E meaningless; cheapness alone does not imply undervaluation.
